name: bg-particle-whirlpool
blurb: 1500 particles orbit in a 3D whirlpool with bloom post-processing glow.
description: Three.js WebGL background rendering instanced particles in orbiting motion. Uses UnrealBloomPass for glow effect and OrbitControls for camera interaction.
use_when: Premium sci-fi or tech-focused hero with high-impact 3D particle dynamics.
avoid_when: Low-end mobile devices, no WebGL, or frame-rate sensitive applications.
a11y: Purely decorative 3D animation with no keyboard equivalent.
